cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(forge_san LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(san_dependency STATIC third_party.cc)
set_target_properties(san_dependency PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(san_dependency PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(san_dependency PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
add_executable(san_app main.cc)
target_link_libraries(san_app PRIVATE san_dependency)
install(TARGETS san_dependency san_app ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES dependency.h DESTINATION include)
